Featuring her signature deep husky vocals, the track shot the teenager to fame, quickly becoming a TikTok favourite and was crowned the biggest Afrobeat Song of 2020 and earning her three MOBO nominations. 
Fast forward to 2024 and Darkoo’s viral hit ‘Favourite Girl’ earned her global critical acclaim, in addition to a two MOBO wins for song of the year and female artist of the year
